notes.title: Demo Performance Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849586/0f85027726237ff391a1ecb383a34890b61d8281.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In this update[/p][p]1- Performance increased by about 20%.[/p][p]2- Sami's health has been reduced by 80%.[/p][p]3- Adjusted the location of the guide widget showing how to unlock weapon attachments.[/p][p]The Minimum System Requirements for the Demo Version are as follows;[/p][p]* Intel Core-i5 2550K 3.4GHz / AMD FX 8120 3.1 GHz[/p][p]* 4 GB RAM[/p][p]* NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 GDDR5 / AMD RX 570 / RX 5500 XT[/p][p]* 12 GB available space[/p][p]Note: Low System Requirements are suitable for playing on the Lowest Settings (Performance Mode).[/p][p]Recommended Version System Requirements are as follows;[/p][p]* Intel Core-i7-10750H / AMD Ryzen 5 5600H[/p][p]* 8 GB RAM[/p][p]* NVIDIA GeForce GTX 3060 / Radeon RX 6600 XT[/p][p]* 12 GB available space[/p][p]Note: Recommended System Requirements are around 80 fps in Quality mode and 40 fps in Ultra Quality mode.[/p]

tags.balance_change: 2- Sami's health has been reduced by 80%.
3- Adjusted the location of the guide widget showing how to unlock weapon attachments.
